title: stanleya tomentosa var. runcinata
intro: Stanleya tomentosa var. runcinata, commonly known as Mountain Tobacco, is a plant species native to North America. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tobacco include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
